tei:div.tei:p: (kha)༄༅// thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ar+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra s+ya ṣā ḍā k+ṣa ra sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po re zhig sngags pa bde ba'i gdan la 'dug ste/ kha dag pa la sogs byas nas sangs rgyas la sogs pa bltas te yang dag par mchod nas/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba byas nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// zhes bya ba la sogs pa bya'o// ji srid sems can thams cad kyi grangs su gtogs pa/ sgo nga las skyes pa'am/ mngal las skyes pa'am/ rdzus te skyes pa'am/ drod gsher las skyes pa'am/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs med pa'am/ 'du shes med pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ yod min med min gyi 'du shes la sogs pa ji srid sems can gyi khams su gtogs pa brjod pa de thams cad bdag gis phung po lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su gzhag par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod la/ yud tsam gyis stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o// de nas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dkar po'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer brgya stong phrag mang po byung bar bsams la/ sems can thams cad kyis thog ma med pa'i dus nas bsags pa'i 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i tshogs khams gsum du gtogs pa dag par byas nas/ yi ge de nyid rang gi snying gar bcug pas/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzugs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sku mdog dkar ba/ phyag bzhi pa/ ral pa'i cod can 'chang ba/ g.yon pas pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yas kyis bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/

phyi ma'i phyag gnyis kyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas phyogs su nor bu 'dzin pa/ de dang 'dra ba'i mdog dang phyag dang mtshan ma can te/ phyi ma'i phyag gis thal mo sbyar ba'o// g.yon phyogs su yi ge drug pa'i rig pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'dra ba'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan can bsgom par bya'o// de nas/ oṃ mahā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsu ra ta s+t+wāṃ a la la la hoḥ aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes bya ba'i byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms nas 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las rig sngags phreng ba'i rnam pa lta bu zhal nas byung ste/ lte bar 'jug cing 'khor lo 'khor ba'i sbyor bar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bzla bar bya'o// de nas 'khor zhing 'jug pa la sogs pa thob nas/ dad pa dang snying rje dang ldan pa bla ma la gus pa'i rnal 'byor pas dus mi ring bar 'grub par 'gyur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzla bar bya'o// de nas ldang ba'i dus su sngags 'di brjod de gnas par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bhā wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes brjod la ji ltar bde bas gnas par bya'o// yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje dang*/ khams pa lo tsā ba dge slong ba ris bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/

stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du thugs rje chen po bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar gyi lus thams cad yongs su gang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phar 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis sangs rgyas thams cad la thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can gyi don la skul ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs pa/ rab tu zhi zhing gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgoms pa la yid gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hrīḥbasgoms pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje rang la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o// phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin nas mdo 'dzin la ma sleb kyi bar tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzla/

grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag drug cu ste/ des las kyi tshogs ji skad bshad pa rnams 'grub la/ byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med do// de nas bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngos nas/ spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o// rang dang gzhan gyi nad kyi zug rngu sel bar 'dod pas/ gang na ba'i sar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥ'i yi ge las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ zug rngu thams cad bsal zhing*/ bde bas gang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags par bya'o// sngags kyi chus bdag dang gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ chu gtsang ma'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin yi ge drug pa bkod nas/ de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ snod yongs su gang bar bsam zhing*/ yi ge drug pas mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs pa dang*/ bkrus pas nad dang zug rngu sel bar byed do// nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o// 'di'i rnal 'byor gyis rtag tu gnas na gnas skabs su nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa byang nas mthar thug byang chub 'grub pa nyid do// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin/ 'phags pas rgya'i yul du yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 'gro skyob yid 'ong snying rje chen po'i sku// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid sgrub thabs bla ma'i gsung bzhin du// gzhan la phan phyir bdag gis bshad par bya// de la 'dir las dang po pas/ jo bo chen po rje'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas byed par 'dod pas rang gi gnas su stan bde ba la skyil krung la sogs pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pas/

thog mar skyabs 'gro bya ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes bsam pa thag pas skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o// de nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis ngo bo thugs rje chen po bsgom par bya'o// snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de'ang dbus kyi che ba/ tha ma gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang bcas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dbu skra phyed ral pa'i thor cog gyen du bsgrengs pa la/ dar dmar po'i cod pan yod pa/ phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba ni rlung gis skyod pa ltar bun ne yod pa'o// phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/

rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo 'bru drug ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ ngag tu jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ mdun gyi lha gsum po spyi bor byon nas so so la thim par bsam mo// de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa la oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pas chos skor du bskor nas yod pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa byas pas sgra thams cad sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang grags pas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad sangs sangs dag par bsam zhing*/

ma ṇi pad+me ci nus bzla'o// mjug tu sngar bzhin mchod nas/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du// zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che// zhes sogs kyis smon lam rnam par dag par btab/ thun mtshams thams cad du 'khor gnyis po rang la bsdus la/ rang jo bo'i nga rgyal gyis sems can thams cad la snying rje bsgom pa dang*/ sems can gyi don ci nus su bya'o// 'dis sems can mang po'i don byed par gyur cig mkhas grub chen po'i dben gnas dam pa bde ba can du bya bral ba dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pas lugs kyi cho ga 'phags pa mnyes byed bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ grangs med bskal par tshogs gnyis rab bsags shing*// dpag med yon tan ma lus mngon gyur nas// tshad med thugs rjes 'gro kun rjes 'dzin pa'i// mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal nas// lhag pa'i lha de tshul bzhin mnyes byed pa'i// sgrub thabs rim pa phyi rol tshogs gsog dang*// gzungs sgrub cho ga rjes gnang bya tshul rnams// legs par bshad kyis dad ldan spro bas nyon// 'dir thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis gnas dben par khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun par byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes mtshan sngags lan gcig sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bh+wa wa sogs brjod pas 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che'i phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du yi ge drug ma gnyis sku mdog rab tu dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/

rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dbyer med du bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pañja ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gsum ka la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad nas yun ring du bsgom/ bsgoms pas skyo na rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dkar po dang de'i mdun nas g.yas skor du yi ge drug pa mgo gyen bstan du gnas pa de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas byang chub kyi sems la sogs pa'i yon tan rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzla bar bya'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag drug kha skong dang bcas pa yin no// thun las ldang ba'i tshe bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes pas 'dod pa'i don zhus nas/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsams la/ dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ byang chub sems ni rin po che sogs dang*/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// sogs bsngo ba smon lam ci shes bya'o// thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na/ dkar gtor gtsang ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bh+wa was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas te mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i oṃ a kā ro lan gsum gyis phul nas sngar bzhin mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstod cing*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas gtor mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol nas spyod lam thams cad du thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs te sems can gyi don la brtson par bya'o// mdun bskyed la brten nas tshogs bsag bya bar 'dod na/ gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa la 'bru gtsang ma'i tshom bu dbus su che ba dang g.yas g.yon du cung zad chung ba re bkod/ de'i mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod g.yas skor dang*/ mdun du gtor ma gcig dang*/

gzhan yang spos mar me zhal zas la sogs pa'i mchod pa ci 'byor pa bsham/ rang gi mdun du rol mo'i chas dang maṇ+ḍal gyi yo byad rnams sta gon bya'o// de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa'i mthar dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs lan gsum gyis byin dbab bo// de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te gdan bsdu ba'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma zhes sogs nas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar snga ma ltar bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gsum dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar e h+ye hi zhes pas spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ dbang lha spyan 'dren nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa'i bar bya/ slar yang mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad par mos nas thal mo sbyar te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye zhing*// mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang mchod// ces dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar tshigs bcad dang sngags 'don pa bsgyur zhing dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis rol mo dbul/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu zhes sogs sam/ mi shes na bzang spyod kyi dbu nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/

sngar gyi bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma sngon bzhin dbul lo// de nas maṇ+ḍal dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs nas/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i yi dam thugs rje chen po la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du sogs spyi dang mthun par brjod/ de lta bu brgya phrag re'i mtshams su/ bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu lan mang du phul ba'i mthar byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod sprin lta bu yid las byung ba'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul bar bsams la/ phal po che'i mdo'i don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtsho zhes pa la sogs pa brjod/ de'i rjes su shes shing nus pa zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i smre ngag brjod pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la hrīḥdang sngags bkod nas de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsams la yi ge drug pa stong phrag la sogs pa bzla'o// de nas slar yang mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa bsdus pa dang*/ 'dod don zhus la rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ khyed kyis sems can don kun sogs kyi rjes su oṃ badz+ra muḥ

tshom bu'i ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes dang*/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ la sogs pas gnas gsum bsrung*/ ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis bya'o// ༈ /bum pa la brten nas gzungs sgrub bya bar 'dod na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa nang rdzas rdor gzungs dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun pa'i mthar mchod gtor gong ltar bshams la/ byin gyis brlabs nas bdag bskyed bsgom/ bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs kyis lha gsum yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de la mchod pa nas gsol ba gdab pa'i bar tshogs gsog gi skabs bzhin rgyas par bya/ bzlas pa'i tshe rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas lha rnams kyi rgyud bskul te sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces brjod cing gzungs thag nas bzung la yi ge drug pa khri phrag la sogs pa bzla'o// mjug tu mchod bstod bsdus pa/ 'dod don zhu ba/ lhag chad skong ba/ bzod par gsol ba rnams gong bzhin byas pa'i mthar dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam mo// de lta bu thun du bcad pa'i sgo nas zhag mang du bya ba ni/ gzungs sgrub rgyas par bya ba'i tshul yin la/

gnas skabs gzhan du khrus chog tsam don du gnyer na/ gzhan rnams snga ma ltar las bum par lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas/ bzlas pa la sogs pa bya'o// gang ltar yang khrus bya tshul dngos ni/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel na de nyid dang*/ ma 'brel na thugs rje chen po'i sku gzugs gzhan me long gi nang du 'char ba byas pa'am/ de yang ma 'byor na yi dam gtso 'khor gsum spyan drangs nas de rnams la sku khrus gsol bar bsams la me long ngos la bum pa'i chu blugs shing*/ 'gro ba'i sgron me spyan ras gzigs mgon la// dri zhim bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol bas// 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis dri ma rnam bsal nas// dri bral sku gsum brnyes pa'i bkra shis shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe kat+ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ khyed ni rang bzhin yongs dag sogs dang*/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la sogs dang*/ khrus kyi khang pa sogs tshigs bcad rnams kyi rjes su sngar gyi sngags brjod pas bkru'o// de nas gos gtsang mas sku phyi ba'i tshul byas la/ de dag sku la sogs dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod/ chu de bum par blugs nas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i yi ge drug ma'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa rang gi spyi bo nas thim par bsam zhing*/ yi ge drug pa brjod nas lan gsum 'thung zhing bkrus pas dang pos nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ gnyis pas shes bya'i sgrib pa dag gsum pas skye med chos sku thob par bsgoms la nam mkha'i gtso 'khor gsum rang la thim par bsam mo// spro na bkru byabs srung gsum gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar byas kyang rung ngo*// rjes gnang byed na tshom bu dang mchod gtor sngar bzhin bshams la byin gyis brlab/ bdag bskyed gong ltar tshom bu bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ mchod gtor bsdus pa dang thugs rgyud skul ba'i bzlas pa bya/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang*/ thar pa'i phan yon rnams zhib tu bshad la/ phan yon can de thob pa'i thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa las/ 'dir gsang sngags yin/ de la rgyud sde rin po che rnam bzhir yod pa las/ rigs sngags 'chang gi sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ so so'i rgyud yin zhing de la rnam pa drug yod pa las pad+ma'i rigs yin/ de la yang rigs kyi gtso bo dang*/ bdag po dang*/ yum dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo dang*/ bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyud yin/ de la rnam grangs mang du yod pa las za ma tog bkod pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' zhig rgyud sde gong ma dang mthun par bkral ba bla ma rdo rje gdan pa las brgyud de/ rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la 'jig rten dbang phyug dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sogs lan gsum brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas te/

de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ swā bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rnams kyi phung khams skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po sogs nas rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gyis slob ma gtso 'khor gsum du bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum gyi sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rol mo bya zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes yang yang brjod/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus thugs rje chen po'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/

rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum gyis bsdus pa las/ thog mar rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams thugs rje chen por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos nas/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang*/ yi ge drug pa gsum mam brgya la sogs pa rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos nas slob dpon la me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas nas khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs rkang pa gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod de me tog gtor ro// dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus de nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thugs rje chen po 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas de'i gsang sngags ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus de nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar 'dzin cing de'i gsang sngags ci nus su bzla bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/

ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam par thugs ka nas rgyang gis byon pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim ste thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ de'i ngang las khyed rang lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gtad pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu nas khyed rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid kyang lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim/ de'ang je chung je phrar gyur te nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces dang gtso bos sogs brjod/ de ltar dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod rnams kyang slob dpon la 'bul/

cha shas nas bzhes su gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces dang*/ deng nas sogs brjod do// rjes mchod bstod nas bkra shis kyi bar sngar bzhin bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni chos tshul 'di la brten nas byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i blo gros can sgom sde kun dga' rdo rjes rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor bya bral ba dpal ldan don grub kyis slob dpon lhan skyes rol pa'i gzhung dang*/ bla ma gong ma'i gsung rab la gzhi byas/ cho ga'i yan lag thun mong ba sbyar du rung ba rnams skabs su babs par sbyar nas e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa 'dis kyang 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho myur du skems par gyur cig/ ༈ /slob dpon zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug la smre sngags kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa byin rlabs can bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ku bā kya sto traṃ a dhiṣ+ṭhi ta nā ma/ bod skad du/ thugs rje chen po la smre sngags kyi bstod pa byin rlabs can zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// dri med dung mdog mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// rnam dag 'od gsal zla ba'i dkyil ltar mdzes// ji ltar mkha' la nyi 'od stong 'bar bzhin// dpa' bo 'od zer stong 'bar lham me ba// srid pa gsum gyi sa mkhan ston par grags// khams gsum 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// byams mgon thugs rje'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs// bdag ni thog ma med pa'i dus mtha' nas// lam log lam stor srid pa'i 'khor bar 'khyams// sngon tshe las log sdig pa spyad pas nongs// sdig pa'i las rnams ci byas rang nongs 'gyod// dar zhing drag po'i las de dbang btsan pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtshor byings gyur te// zhe sdang 'bar ba'i mes ni rang rgyud bsregs// gti mug mun pa'i tshogs kyis shes rab rmongs// 'dod chags rgya mtsho'i nang du rnam shes byings// nga rgyal chen po'i ri bos ngan 'gror mnan// phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pas 'khor bar g.yengs// bdag tu lta ba'i mdud pa dam pos bcings// 'dod pa me mdag 'dra ba'i 'obs su lhungs// sdug bsngal drag po'i 'dam rdzab char ltar babs// me khams nyi ma'i gdugs ni steng nas tsha// chu khams sa yi rlan ni 'og nas grang*// phyi yi ser bu'i ngad ni thad kar tsha// kun nas 'khrugs pa'i rlung ni khong nas ldangs// de lta'i sdug bsngal shin tu bzod dka' yang*// sdom pa'i yi dam gzhig tu ga la rung*// sdug bsngal kun dang bsdos nas sdom bsrungs shing*// mos pa'i dad pas 'phags mchog mi gtong na// 'phags mgon 'gro don mi mdzad ci la dgongs// byams mgon ci slad bdag la thugs mi brtse// bdag 'dra'i blun rmongs las ngan sdig po che// las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes// skyes pas 'gyod de las la yi re chad// yi chad 'gyod kyang las dbang bcos su med// las kyi shugs ni chu bo'i rgyun dang 'dra// las dbang chu klung zlog par rab tu dka'// bka' la zhugs kyang bka' bzhin rngo ma thogs// lus ngag yid gsum sdig pa'i dbang du gyur// sdig pa'i las dbang drag po'i me 'bar bas// rnam shes dbang po'i myu gu gdungs gyur te// phung po sgyu ma'i lus 'dis mi bzod na// byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam// nyi ltar 'od 'bar zla ltar mdangs gsal ba'i// thugs rje'i zhal nyid mthong bar 'tshal lags kyang*// thog ma med nas ma rig ling thog gis// ldong ba'i chu bur mig gis ma mthong na// 'gro ba'i mgon khyod da lta gang na bzhugs// sdug bsngal drag po shin tu mi bzod pas// shin tu skrag cing skyi g.ya' rab 'jigs nas// dung dung gdung ba'i smre sngags 'di 'don cing*// nyam thag phongs pa'i nga ros 'bod lags na// byams mgon thugs rje can gyis bzod lags sam// nam zhig 'chi 'phos lus brjes gyur pa'i tshe// gnyen bshes grogs dang bral te gshin rjes 'khrid// de tshe 'jig rten nye dus mi bstongs te// las kyi dbang gis bdag 'dra gcig pur 'khrid// dus der bdag la mgon skyabs ma mchis na// byams mgon khyed kyis 'khor bar bdag gtong ngam// las kyis mnar ba'i skye bo bdag 'dra ba// thog ma med pa'i dus nas log brtags pas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas ma thar te// bskal pa dpag med skye ba ji snyed du// sngon chad lus blangs grangs med zhig gyur te// sha rus bsags na 'jig rten gtos dang mnyam// rnag khrag bsags na rgya mtsho chen po tsam// las 'phro bsags na bsam 'das brjod mi langs// khams gsum bgrangs shing skye ba kun brgyud kyang*// byas pa'i las rnams don med chud zos te// skye ba grangs med ji snyed de tsam la// skye ba gcig cig kho na tsam gyi las// bla med don du sbyangs gyur ji tsam na// de tsam byas pa'i las la don rab yod// sha khrag 'dus pa'i lus blangs 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal drag pos srid pa'i btson rar tshud// mi zad sdug bsngal drag po 'di 'dra na// nyes byas thams cad rang gi las las byung*// thugs rje chen pos las rnams rgyun bcad de// nyon mongs las kyi rlung rnams bzlog tu gsol// nyon mongs las kyi rlung 'di dbang btsan pas// ma rig mun pa'i nang du gtan 'khyams na// ye shes sgron me'i zer gyis mi gzigs sam// nyes byas las kyi 'bras bu mi zad na// thugs rje chen pos phrin las mi mdzad dam// dug gsum bzod dka'i nad kyis gdungs lags na// thugs rjes thabs mkhas sman gyis mi gso'am// phyin ci log gi g.yang sar lhungs lags na// thugs rjes myur mgyogs phyag gis mi 'dzin nam// sdug bsngal drag po'i las kyi me 'bar na// thugs rjes bsil ba'i chu rgyun mi 'bebs sam// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su sbyangs sbyangs nas// nam zhig rang gis 'bras bu thob pa'i tshe// 'phags pa'i thugs rjes ci 'tshal don ma mchis// sems can las 'phro btsan par bzhag na kwa

/'phags pa'i thugs rjes su la ci zhig bgyi// 'phags mchog khyed la thugs rje'i stobs mnga' bas// yal yol btang snyoms le lo ma mdzad par// snying nas gzigs shig thugs rje rgyal ba'i lha// re sa gzhan na med do thugs rjes zungs// byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la smre sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa byin rlabs can 'di nyid lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa/ mthong lam rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman go bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ki shwa rā ya/ 'gro skyobs yid 'ong snying rje'i sku// spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas// gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas// blo dman go bde bshad kyis nyon// gnas dben par stegs bu khebs ldan la maṇ+ḍal gyi khar tshom bu dbus su che ba gcig dang*/ g.yas g.yon du chung ba re bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ bum pa dri bzang gi chu dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa stegs bu ji ltar 'os par bzhag dung chos rdor gzungs mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa rnams oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar rigs 'gre/ dril gsil dang dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la=

dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhe thag pa nas skyabs 'gro ci nus bya'o// bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol lan gcig de nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o lan gsum/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thal mo sbyar la/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan gzigs gtso 'khor rnams la 'dud// ces pas phyag bya/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod yon me tog la sogs pa thogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo spros nas mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod/ thal mo sbyar nas ngag tu/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar lan gsum/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs nas/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gsum gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de yang dbus che ba tha ma gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/

dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang bcas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dbu skra phyed ral pa'i thor cog gyen du bsgrengs pa la/ dar dmar po'i cod pan yod pa/ phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba ni rlung gis skyod pa ltar bun ne yod pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo 'bru drug ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na mu tig gi phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs shing*/ spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+yā lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/

thal mo sbyar te ngag tu/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ mdun gyi lha gsum spyi bor byon nas so so la thim/ gtso bo'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa la oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pas chos skor du bskor nas yod pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa byas pas/ sgra thams cad sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang grags pas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad sangs sangs dag par bsams la/ ma ṇi pad+me ci nus bzla'o// mjug tu sngar bzhin mchod nas/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ mdun gyi tshom bu la dmigs te/ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gsum gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po zhes pa nas gsum du gyur pa zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dbus su thugs rje chen po zhes pa nas thugs kar gzigs pa zhes pa'i bar kyang gong bzhin/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bdag bskyed bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi'i phyag tu bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs nas/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang*/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar la mchod sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing*/ mthar dril gsil dang dharmā ra ṇi brjod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang ba nas nang du zhes pa'i bar mchod pa byin rlabs ltar gong bzhin la/ gtor ma kha dog dri mo nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ thal mo khong stong gi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin mthar/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa bya/ de nas bum pa/ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang bcud kyis gang ba/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba bum nang la babs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/

ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ 'di la lha bskyed pa med de bcu gcig zhal gyi bum sgrub dang 'dra bar 'dug go /de nas slob ma bos la khrus byas/ gral la 'khod pa na me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje can des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis las/ sngags kyi theg par rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa las/ 'dir bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi khongs su gtogs pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud sde rnams las 'byung ba ltar thugs rje'i dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i slad lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du gsol na/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi snying rje chen po gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid kyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po rā hū la gup+ta ste bod skad du sgra gcan 'dzin sbas par grags pa de nyid la gnang*/ des sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa de nyid la gnang*/ des jo bo chen po nyid lo bcu dgu'i bar du zhabs pad mnyes pa gsum gyis bsten pa'i gung thang pa nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba la gnang*/ de la rong pa phyag sor pa shes rab 'bar gyis lo gsum du bsten nas/ spyir jo bo nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa mtha' dag dang*/

lhag par spyan ras gzigs kyi chos skor rnams zhus shing*/ lo tsā ba chen pos kyang*/ khyod kyis sgrub pa'i gnas 'di lta bu zhig tu sgrubs shig 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes lag sor dgon pa'i lung bstan yang mdzad pa bzhin/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad ling gis bskyur nas bla mas lung bstan pa'i lag sor dgon par bzhugs te/ nye gnas dang yang mi mjal bar gsol pa bug sgo nas blangs te/ sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas lo gsum nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong*/ lung bstan te/ khyod kyis tshe 'di nyid du mthong lam thob nas slob ma yang sum cus zhal mthong bar 'gyur gsungs/ de la rong pa'i bu bzhir grags pa sogs slob ma mang du byon pa'i nang nas/ wa yu ba shes rab tshul khrims kyis phyag sor ba yun ring du bsten/ jo bo nas brgyud pa'i chos skor dang*/ khyad par spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams ngag ma lus pa gsan/ lung bstan gnang ba bzhin thugs rje chen po bsgrubs pas lo lnga nas thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong*/ theg pa chen po'i sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa brnyes pa des 'phags pa lce sgom shes rab rdo rje dang*/ mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis la gsungs/ de gnyis ka tshogs lam chen po'i sar bzhugs pa yin zhing*/ lce sgom gyis thog mar lha sa brag lha klu phug tu lo brgyad sgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'phags pa gtso 'khor gsum zhal mthong zhing*/ de nas bzung gtan du zhal mthong ba yin gsungs/ bla ma mnga' ris pas ru mtshams kyi brag phug tu bsgrubs pas lo bzhi nas zhal mthong*/ 'tsho ba mi ma yin gyis sbyor ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ de gnyis ka la grub chen dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ges gsan nas/ zhag rer skyo tsha phor pa re res myong*/ res ma myong bar thal ba dang chu bsres nas btung ba mdzad/ nyin mtshan khor yug tu sgrub pa mdzad pas/

lo phyed dang bzhi song ba na/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gyi dkyil na thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum 'dzum pa'i mdangs ye re bzhugs pa mjal bas/ jo bo thugs rje re chung na/ ngas lo phyed dang bzhir zhag rer skyo tsha phor pa re yang ma myong bar 'bad pa la/ de bas snga bar zhal mi ston par byas pa/ jo bo'i zhal nas bu khyod kyis sgrub pa byas pa zhag gsum nas nga dang 'du 'bral med par yod pa yin te/ khyod rang gi las ma dag pa dang mthong na dga' ba'i re bas bkag pa yin gsungs/ de nas bzung dngos nyams rmi lam du zhal yang yang gzigs shing*/ lhag par spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa dang mjal bas/ nga dang khyod ni dbyer med de// skyer pa sgang 'di po ta la// zhes 'phags pa rang nyid dang dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs/ snyigs ma'i dus su zhal mthong gi brgyud pa mang du 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin slob ma yang lnga bcus zhal mthong*/ des 'gro mgon sangs rgyas gnyan ston la gsungs te/ skyer sgang du dbyar thog dgun thog bcu gsum bzhugs/ gdams ngag chig brgyud ma lus pa gnang*/ lo gsum bsgrubs pas/ phyag bzhi pa/ kha sar+pa ṇi/ bcu gcig zhal/ phyag stong spyan stong rnams mthong*/ slob ma bcu gcig gis zhal mthong ba'i lung bstan mdzad pa bzhin byung gsungs/ de nas rje sems dpa' chen po'i bar la brgyud pa thams cad la zhal gzigs pa rkyang byung*/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal snga nas kun mkhyen rin po che la 'di gnang dus ma ṇi bye chen bdun song zhing rjes la song ba dang byas na dung lhag pa song yod tshod yin gsungs/ kun mkhyen rin po che nas rdo ring rin po che la 'di'i rjes gnang mdzad dus/ sems dpa' chen po yan la zhal gzigs pa rkyang byung 'dug na'ang nga khyer kha chung bas zhal ma gzigs/ khyed skyes bu dam pa gcig 'dug pas sgrub na zhal gzigs yong gsungs pa bzhin rdo ring rin po che la rdo ring rang du'ang gtso 'khor gsum gyi zhal gzigs/

rjes nas tsha mo rang du'ang zhal gzigs pa sogs zhal gzigs kyi lo rgyus mang zhing*/ kho bos thob pa'i brgyud pa ni skyer sgang pa'i lugs ltar na/ skyer sgang pa nas/ gnyan ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum/ gnyan ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje lha mchog seng ge rdo rje 'chang bud+dha siṃ ha/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros/ mkhan chen nam mkha' 'chi med/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang byams pa rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po'am/ yang na 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros nas/ mchog sprul rin po che byams pa bstan 'dzin phrin las/ byams pa phrin las yon tan/ byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyi bar du byon pa dang*/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ spyan ras gzigs dngos dpal sa skya pa kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇa/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*/ de la rje sems dpa' chen pos gsan pa nas bzung brgyud pa'i chu bo gcig tu 'dres shing*/ nye brgyud ltar na 'phags pa thugs rje chen po nyid kyis mus chen sems dpa' chen po la dngos su gnang ba sogs brgyud srol rnam par dag pa de dag las rim par 'ongs pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/

khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs/ tshom bu bdun ma tshig lhug gam/ yang na sa gzhi spos chus sogs gang rigs/ tshig lhug ltar na zhu ba'i yon du zhes dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'di spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum du bskyed pa skyabs gnas dam pa thams cad kyis bskor ba'i drung du khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar/ zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrub pa'i slad du/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas snang grags kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar mdun bskyed bzhin la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po zhes dang*/

dbus su khyed rang rnams thugs rje chen po zhes pa tsam khyad par ro// gzhan 'dra/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ a be sha ya aḥ.āḥ lan kha yar brjod cing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod la bum chu khyor bar sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs te sku'i rjes gnang thob pa yin/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ni slob dpon spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ lan gsum/ slob mas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs bya/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das gtso 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/

khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim nas lhag pa'i lha'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres par bsams la/ spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin no// de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi gsan pa yin pas dam tshig bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ rjes gnang thob pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal tshig lhug bcad gang rung gong bzhin la/ lhug pa ltar na thob pa'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o zhes sogs dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te nas/ spyad du gsol/ des spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas kyang rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po re mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gong bzhin/ rdor sems yig brgya bzla min skabs sbyar/ ma 'byor pa dang nas/ de kun 'phags pas bzod par gsol// oṃ khyod kyis sogs nas gsol/ badz+ra muḥs tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas sogs dang*/ 'god par shog skyon gyis ma gos sogs nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog ces sogs ci shes bya'o// zhes spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang 'di la brgyud pa'i rnam grangs jo lugs/ sa lugs/ skyer sgang pa nas bzung zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa sogs mi 'dra ba gsum tsam 'dug kyang ngo bo gcig pas 'dir bdag bskyed mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rab sor bzhag dang*/ rjes gnang gi chings mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams lha bzhi'i gras kyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skabs su gsungs pa de sor bzhag pa ni chings rgyas pa'i lugs yin zhing*/

bsdu na bdag mdun lung gsum gyi chings ldan gyis kyang don 'grub pa'i nag 'gros rnam gzhag cung zad dang bcas pa 'di'ang*/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la 'brug chos rje kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes bya bas yi ge'i lam nas bskul ba bzhin sbyar ba'o// 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo yi// ye shes gzigs pas yid can kun// gru 'dzin ri bo'i dga' tshal du// deng nas bzung ste 'jug gyur cig /ces dpal sa skya pa chen po 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyi gsung rab 'di nyid la brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang kha skong sogs skabs su babs pa'i gsal byed cung zad cig yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter chen gyi chos skor mang du thos pa'i skal ba can shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses bgyis pa sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /'phags pa thugs rje chen po brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs zla snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// snying rje'i dbang phyug grub chen sgra gcan 'dzin// mar me mdzad dpal tshul khrims rgyal ba'i zhabs// shes rab 'bar dang shes rab tshul khrims dang*// shes rab rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// skyer sgang chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston che// brtson 'grus seng ge shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang rdo rje gzhon nu dang*// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnams la= /gzhan yang ston mchog slob dpon dze tā ri// rdo rje gdan pa ba ri lo tsā ba// brtse chen snying po'i gdams pa'i bka' babs pa// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba= /rgyud srol kun 'dus dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal// rat+na war+dha lha mchog seng ge dang*// sangs rgyas seng ge mus chen nam mkha'i mtshan// mchog legs rdo rje rnams la= /bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// kun dga' lhun grub legs 'byung kun blo'i zhabs// bstan 'dzin phrin las phrin las yon tan dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab mthus bdag gzhan kun// nges par 'byung dang byang chub sems gnyis 'byongs// 'phags pa'i gsang gsum rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas// sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu//

༈ /thugs rje chen po lha gsum pa'i bsnyen thabs zhar byung dang bcas pa gzhan phan snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ 'dir sa lugs dang skyer sgang lugs zung du 'brel ba'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa gtong bar 'dod na/ rjes gnang dang gdams ngag gi lung legs par thob pas gnas dben zhing rang dbang 'dus pa'i sar/ 'byor na bris 'bur gyi sku gang yang rung ba'i mdun du gtor ma dkar zlum dang*/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bsham/ gza' skar sbyor byed bzang po'i yar ngo'i dgongs thun nas brtsams te thun bzhi'i rim pas nyams len la 'jug sgrub thabs mkhas grub gong mas mdzad pa khungs ldan gang gi steng nas nyams su blang yang rung mod/ 'on kyang mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa 'di rgya gzhung dang shin tu mthun zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas legs/ gal te gtso 'khor gsum gsal mi theb na bdag bskyed gtso rkyang kho nas 'thus par gsungs pas/ de ltar na 'phags pa rin po che'i yig cha ltar nyams su blang ngo*// 'di'i cho ga'i yan lag phal cher bla med dang mthun na'ang*/ kun spyod rgyud sde 'og ma ltar mdzad pa brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros las 'byung bas khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas sha chang sgog btsong phyi dro'i kha zas sogs spang*/ grub na zas dkar gsum la bsten pa'i gdan gcig bya/ gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ thun gnyis sam/ snga thun gyi mgor mchod pa byin rlabs dang*/ mjug tu gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

thal mo khong stong gi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ya lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// thun dang thun mtshams rnams su snang grags rtog gsum 'phags pa'i gsang ba gsum gyi nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems kyi rnal 'byor la rtsal du 'don/ de lta bu'i rim pas grangs bsnyen gyi tshad ni/ rab 'bum phrag so gnyis/ 'bring 'bum phrag bdun/ tha ma 'bum phrag gsum zhes dang*/ yang 'bum phrag bco brgyad dang drug cu bzla ba sogs gsungs kyang*/ 'bum phrag drug cu'am/ so gnyis nges par bzla/ dus bsnyen zla ba gsum/ mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rab dngos dang*/ 'bring nyams sam rmi lam du zhal mthong ba/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra thos pa/ tha ma rmi lam du me tog dkar po dang*/ shel dkar gyi phreng ba rnyed pa/ nyi ma shar ba/ khrus byas pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa sogs dge ba'i mtshan ma ci rigs pa mthong ba'o// bsnyen pa grub nas kha skong bcu cha'i sbyin sreg mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas mdzad pa ltar bya/ sgrub pa dmigs bsal ma bshad kyang*/ mdun bskyed rjes gnang gi skabs ltar gsal btab nas/ mchod phreng*/ maṇ+ḍal/ bstod pa/ gsol 'debs sogs rgyas par bya ba phyi rol tshogs bsag gi rim pa dang*/ bum pa la brten pa'i gzungs sgrub bya tshul 'jam mgon dpal ldan don grub pa'i yig char shes shing*/ gzungs sgrub byas pa'i bum chu bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs rten sel med kyi phabs gta' dang bcas ril bur dril ba dang*/

slar ril bu'i steng du lha yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas gzungs sgrub dang tshul mtshungs pa'i bum sgrub bya tshul gyi man ngag kyang gzhan don gnyer ba rnams kyis lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas bsgrubs te mi dang dud 'gro sogs la sbyin pa dang*/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung chen por smon lam dang bcas te dor ba sogs bgyis na phan yon tshad med pa 'byung bar gsungs/ 'di dang 'brel bar smyung gnas kyi cho ga btang tshul kyang gsungs te/ de yang sbyor ba sdom pa blang pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi 'di nyid kyi bdag mdun bum pa sgrub pa khrus kyi cho ga rjes chog dang bcas pa btang*/ rkyang khug rjes gsum la sdom pa'i spang blang rnams smyung gnas kyi cho ga spyi ltar dang*/ thun mtshams rnams su thugs rje chen po'i snang brnyan sogs rten gsum la phyag dang mchod pa ci 'grub tu bya'o// bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas las kyi tshogs la/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sbyin sreg gis sgrub pa'i tshul dang*/ yig rnying las las tshogs thor bu rgya cher bshad pa'i nyer mkho bsdus pa mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsung rab las 'byung ba dang*/ 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab las cung zad 'byung ba dag nyams su blangs pas rang gzhan la phan bde'i 'bras bu 'phral du ster ba ni nges pa'o// zhes pa'ang mang du thos pa'i bya bral ma ṇi ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam kho nas yig cha snga ma rnams kyi snying po mdor bsdus te sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/ ༈ /thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga phrin las rab rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i gzugs// spyan ras gzigs dbang gdugs dkar srid na gsal// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med la btud de// bzlas brjod nus 'byin sbyin sreg 'chad la spro// thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/

sbyin sreg la bzhi ste/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid do// phyi'i sbyin sreg la bzhi las/ dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba thab ni sngar sa chog ma byas pa'i sa phyogs yin na gang du bya ba'i gnas su rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin btang la/ dang po gnyis kyi phrin bcol gyi rjes su/ sa phyogs 'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha mchod pa dang sems can gyi don bgyid bar 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsal zhing sbyin sreg gi cho ga mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de gshegs gsol sogs bya/ bgegs gtor gyi rjes su sa'i phyogs 'dir sogs gong ltar las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang khro bo'i sngags brjod cing rol mo bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis phyogs kun tu brabs pas bgegs thams cad byer bar bsam pa ni sa bslang ba'o// de nas lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa phyogs lag pas bcags la sa phyogs nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/ de bzhin du oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du brjod pas sa phyogs skyon thams cad dang bral bar bsams pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// der zhi ba'i thab khung brus pa'am/ brtsigs pa'am/ bris thab stabs gang bde lag len ltar bya/ thab kyi dbus su spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs rang gang byed kyi lha tshogs kyi mtshan ma 'god dgos la/ 'dir gtso 'khor gsum pa'i dbang du byas nas/ de'i mtshan ma me tog gi tshom bu'am rdul tshon sogs kyis tshom bu dgod/ zhal 'jig rten pa'i nub tu phyogs ba'i dbang du byas/
bud shing ni tsher ma can ma yin pa 'o ma can gyi shing sor

yam shing gi tshad kyang 'di nyid do/ brgyad pa yan chad khru gang tsam brtsig de ma 'byor na srog chags med pa'i ba lang sogs kyi lci bas thab kyi kha sbyor gyi steng nas zlum por brtsigs la nang gi shar lhor ting lo che ba zhig kyang bzhag go /me ni rdo dang lcags gtsubs pa las byung ba ma yin pa rgyun bzhag gi me'am 'o ma can gtsubs pa sogs las byung ba'o// rdzas ni bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas dang gtor ma dang ku sha'i chun po la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams gtsang zhing gya nom pa sta gon bya'o// bsham thabs ni thab kyi mtha' skor thams cad byi dor legs par byas la dri bzang pos byugs/ thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan nang tshang can sogs shar du phyogs par bya/ mdun du rdor dril gyi bar du dgang gzar blugs kha sbyar la bzhag dri bzang gi chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa dang*/ grub na thab dang sgrub pa po'i bar du 'jim pa las byas pa'i me yol dkar zhal gyis byugs pa la wam̐ yig dkar po bris pa'ang bsham/ rang gi g.yon thab kyi g.yas nas chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ 'phags pa dang*/ me lha la zlum gtor re bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon phyogs su rang ngos nas brtsams te thab kyi g.yon nas/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang*// 'bras dang so ba nas sran ma// gro dang dūr+wa ku shu rnams// lag len ji bzhin legs par bsham// rdzas rnams bsdu na yam shing*/ til dkar nag mar dang gsum mo// ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang dpal 'bar rnams stabs gang bder bzhag yo byad thams cad dri bzang gi chu gtor te bzhag go /de nas snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus bya/ 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag nyid sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing nus pa dbyung ba dang sdig pa dang bar chad zhi ba'i phyir sbyin sreg gi cho ga la 'jug snyam pa'i bsam pa brtan pos sngar bshams pa'i stan la kha shar du blta/

skyil krung ngam pus 'khyud dang bcas pas tsog pur rkang pa gnyis cung zad bsnol ba rig byed 'don pa lta bu'i spyod lam gyis 'dug go /dngos gzhi la bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma'am/ rje mus chen nam/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa lta bu rang stabs gang bde'i bdag bskyed bya/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ma grub kyi bar la lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' ba la bslab/ dpal 'bar la gong du bshad pa'i me sbar te lag pa gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing ma ṇi lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar la me gso/ de nas khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyangs pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang gzar blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing blugs gzar gyis mar bud shing la khyab par blugs te/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ thab dang yo byad bsang ba ni/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bsang chu la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas sngags de nyid brjod cing ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab dang yo byad rnams la gtor/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags rgyas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang 'phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dang*/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can sa dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad khyab pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur/

ces brjod la mchod rdzas rnams rang rang gi sngags dang phyag rgya byin gyis brlabs/ bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hās yam shing*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hās mar/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hās 'bru/ oṃ swa swā hās rdzas thams cad bkru/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās rdzas thams cad sbyang*/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣā ya swā hā zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rgyar khru gang ba/ dpangs su khru phyed pa kha sgyer dang mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ thab kyi nang du ram̐ las me dkar gsal du 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes dkar po la chibs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sma ra dang smin ma dkar ser 'bar ba/ ag tshom 'phyangs pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam/ de'i thugs ka'i ram̐ dang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzāḥzhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtser bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po// thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas oṃ ag+ni sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal por ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ de nas ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam ste/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod// oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du dgram mo// de nas bsang chu phyogs kun tu gtor te/ a mṛ ta'am/ yak+ṣa brjod pas bgegs bsal lo// de nas gzar bu gnyis byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/

me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā dī byā mahā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bah+nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te me lha'i zhal du phul/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul/ de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ mchog sbyin phyag rgyas dbul te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ til lam yungs kar/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ zho dang sbyar ba'i zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ 'bras so ba/ oṃ mahā be gā ya swā hā/ nas/ oṃ mahā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma r+yai swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ dūrba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes pas ku sha rnams 'bul ba'am/ yang na sngags de rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs nas ag+na ye 'ba' zhig gis phul/ gang ltar yang nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor ba'i mthar/ bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyer 'tshe dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba gsang sngags kyi lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes las sngags kyi spel tshig sde tshan re re'i mthar brjod do// de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ bstod pa sngar ltar byas te/ mar dgang gzar gang thab tu blugs te badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod la/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo// 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig le gsum du gyur pa las dbus kyi che ba/

g.yas g.yon du chung ba dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro ba/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma dpung pa'i steng nas mar cung zad 'phyangs pa/ dar dmar po'i cod pan can/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas mu tig gi phreng ba bgrang ba/ g.yon 'og mas pad+ma dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa dang*/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo gtsug nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smig phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo 'bru drug ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba bgrang ba/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pas/ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes pas spyan drangs te/

oṃ ār+ya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngags rgyas spyan drang*/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ de'i mtha' bskor du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsams la/ de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha thams cad kyi zhal cung zad gdangs pa sogs sngar ltar gsal btab/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa lan 'ga' zhig brjod pas mar la bsngags te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis blugs gzar gyis mar blugs pas dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā dī bya zhes sogs swā hā'i gong du bdag gis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod de/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la lha thams cad kyi zhal du dus gcig la phul bar bsam/ de lta bu lan gsum la sogs pas byon skyems phul/ de nas yo ga ltar mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun 'dod yon lnga rnams kun rig ltar ro// bstod pa ni/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs ci shes pas bstod/ de nas yam shing nas brtsams te bsreg rdzas rnams sde tshan re re'i thog mar so so'i sngags
