bo dhi bṛk+ṣa sogs/ gsum mam lnga la sogs pa dang*/ mjug tu spel tshig gong ltar brjod cing brgya rtsa la sogs pa ji tsam 'byor pa 'bul/ rdzas thams cad ma ṇi 'ba' zhig gis phul/ de nas til dkar nag mdun du 'du byas la bdag gzhan gyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa til nag la thim/ dkar po la shes bya'i sgrib pa thim/ mar la de ma yin pa'i sgrib pa rnams thim zhes brjod cing bsams la/ ma ṇi zlos shing phul bas sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bor bsam/ bsnyen pa kha skong la bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i grangs 'bul dgos pas brgya phrag re'i mtshams su gong gi spel tshig sbyar te til 'ba' zhig dbul/ bsnyen pa dung song na zla ba'i bar du dgos pa sogs rig pas dpyad do// rdzas rnams kyi grangs dang yam shing dang mar ni tshod dang sbyar te sgrub g.yog gis logs nas 'bul/ bsreg rdzas rnams rdzogs pa dang gong byon skyems kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar mar dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba rol mo'i bar dang bstod pa bya/ 'das pa'i gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro lan gsum/ mchod bstod bya/ jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub dang*/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo// yig brgya ci nus dang ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgras ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ srin lag gis thab kyi rdul cung zad blangs la dpral bar bskus te dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ thab tu mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg pa dang bcas pas blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod de/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur par bsams la/ sreg rdzas rnams kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig gam nyer gcig la sogs pa ci 'byor pa phul/ mthar byon zan gyi skabs ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gang ba'i sbyin sreg tu phul/ me lha 'khor bcas la gtor ma cig bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ ag+ni sa pa ri wā ra ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lngas phul/ mtshan sngags re re nas sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang*/ spro na/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// sogs kyis kyang bstod la/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bar chad dang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+ni gats+tsha zhes dang*/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed de/

me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo sogs smon lam ci shes dang*/ che ba'i che mchog sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa yin na me ma shi'i bar du mi bsgul/ shi ba dang gzhan reg tu mi gzhug par rang gis phyags/ thal ba 'dod pa rnams la'ang sbyin zhing lhag ma 'bab chu la sogs par dor/ thun mong gi dngos grub tsam la 'phral du phyags pas rung ngo*// thab kyi shul dang nye 'khor thams cad dri zhim po'i chus byugs te/ me tog la sogs pa gtor la bkra shis bya'o// rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ rgyas pa'i thab lag len ltar bya/ dus snga dro sa 'ja' li sogs la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug yam shing tsher ma can ma yin pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing khru gang ba'o// bsreg rdzas gtso bo zas mchog dang*/ tshe rgyas pa la dūrba'o// rdzas gzhan rnams 'dra/ bsham gyi go rim/ yam shing mar dang zas mchog til sogs/ rgyan gos ser po bya/ dgang blugs rin chen khu tshur gyis bzung*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ spel tshig tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'das pa'i lha la gtso bo la rigs bdag rin 'byung*/ lha rnams 'dzum zhing mdangs dang 'od zer ser po 'phro bas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams grangs brgya dang brgyad re'i mtshams su spel tshig bya/ rdzas gtso bo zas mchog gam/ dūrba la grangs bzung*/ cho ga'i chings sngar zhi ba dang 'dra'o// dbang gi sbyin sreg ni/ dbang gi thab lag len ltar bya/ rgyan gos dmar/ yam shing shing skyur po sor brgyad pa bya/ bsreg rdzas gtso bo me tog dmar po'am 'bras dmar por bsgyur ba/

bsham gyi go rim/ yam shing mar dang me tog dmar/ zas mchog til so nas dang gro sogs/ dus dgong mo pad+ma'i 'dug stangs bya/ pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ bsreg rdzas me tog dmar po sogs la grangs bzung*/ lnga bcu re'i mtshams su spel tshig rgyal po yul 'khor grong khyer pa la sogs pa wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ 'das pa'i me lha gtso bo la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ lha rnams 'od zer dmar po 'phro zhing sdud pas 'gro ba dbang du sdud pa'i las mdzad/ cho ga'i chings snga ma'i rigs pas shes so// drag po'i sbyin sreg ni/ drag po'i thab lag len ltar dang*/ yam shing tsher ma can gyi shing sor bcu pa/ khyad par gyi rdzas sha khrag dug la sogs pa/ go rim mchod rdzas g.yas/ bsreg rdzas g.yon nas yam shing dang*/ sha khrag la sogs pa dang til zas mchog sogs/ stan med pa'am srab pa/ kha lhor blta/ dus nyin phyed dam nam phyed/ gos rgyan nag g.yas bskums g.yon brkyang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung*/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nag po las 'od zer nag po 'phro ba mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ spel tshig gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ 'das pa'i me lha gtso bo la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ mdangs dang 'od zer nag po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dgra bgegs la sogs pa tshar bcad pa'i las mdzad/ grangs drug cu'i mtshams su spel tshig rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas dbul/ khyad par gyi rdzas stong la sogs pa dbul/ gzhan phal cher snga ma'i rigs pas shes so// de ltar rgyas dang dbang drag gi /me dang thab kyi dbyibs la sogs// rgyas par sngags gzhung rgya mtsho dang*// mthong brgyud lag len las shes gyis// sdig sbyong gi sbyin sreg chen mo sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o// nang gi sbyin sreg ni/

rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar thugs rje chen po tshon gang pa zhig bsam/ zas la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsdus la/ lag pa dgang gzar/ kha hom khung du bsams la gsol bas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad tshig nas ye shes pa'i zhal du bde ba'i ngo bor gsol bar bsam/ de nas ye shes pa rang la bsdu/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par bsam/ gsang ba'i sbyin sreg ni/ rang byung lte ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// rnam pa a'am hūm̐ zhig bzhugs// 'phro 'du gnyis med me zhig sbar// zag bcas nyon mongs thams cad sreg /tshig pa med na bde ba yin// me dang bsreg rdzas gnyis su med// sreg mkhan med na tshig pa yin// de kho na nyid kyi sbyin sreg ni// mtha' bral stong pa'i hom khung du// rang rig rang gsal me zhig sbar// the tshom yid gnyis gnyis ka sreg /bsgrub bya sgrub byed gnyis pa tshig /zhar byung gi sbyin sreg ni/ nang nub kyi lto g.yo bas dus su/ me 'bar ba'i nang du ma las nyi ma bsam/ de'i steng du hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po bskyed/ bud shing la sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bsdus la me btang bas ye shes pa'i zhal du sdig sgrib tshig nas/ bde ba'i ngo bor gsol bar bsam/ de ni zhar byung gi sbyin sreg go /de ltar thugs rje chen po yi// sbyin sreg cho ga sbyar ba'i dges// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du ni// las bzhi'i phrin las lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer mang pos yun ring por bskul zhing*/ nye char bla ma rin chen grags pas gser gyi me tog dang bcas bskul nas/ ma ṇi ba sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'tsho byed rin chen phun tshogs kyis bgyis so// ༈ /skyer sgang lugs kyi yi ge drug pa'i nyer mkho cung zad cig bzhugs// oṃ swa sti/ skyer sgang pas mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po'i chos skor las nyer mkho btus pa/

thog mar gzungs chu byed par 'dod na/ snod gas chag med pa rin po che la sogs pa'i snod du/ chu srog chags can la sogs pa ma yin pa gtsang ma blugs la mdun du bzhag rang yi ge drug par bsgom/ mdun du spyan ras gzigs zhal bcu gcig pa rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs la/ jo bo'i yi ge drug pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phros pa'i sna las me tog la sogs pa jo bo la phul bar bsam/ ngag tu sngags 'di brjod par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod la mchod pa 'bul/ de nas rang gi byed na rang gi ming gzhug gzhan gyi byed na che ge mo'i nad dang gdon dang gnod pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi g.yon gyi bum pa na ril ba spyi blugs yod pa/ de yo bar byas nas de'i nang nas bdud rtsi dkar me re re chu'i nang du blugs par bsam zhing yi ge drug pa sum brgya'am brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de nas jo bo la mchod pa rnams snga ma bzhin phul la gshegs su gsol/ de nas khrus byed khar rang srung ba la yi ge drug pa lan bdun bzlas la/ sngar gyi spyan ras gzigs spyan drangs la sngar gyi spyi blugs nas bdud rtsi byung bas sdig sgrib dang nad dang gdon la sogs pa thams cad nag nyil nyil song bar bsam/ gzhan la blugs na'ang de bzhin du byas la mgo nas mar blugs/ 'bar ba la sogs pa 'ong na rang gi snying gar/ hūm̐ ljang gu las rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu bskyed la/ mi de'i mgo thog na mar song bar bsams la/ de'i steng du blug go /dge ba bsngo'o// srung skud byed na/

shi ba'i bal ma yin pa la/ bsgril dus su 'jur bu med pa dang*/ ma chad pa dang*/ ma shor ba bya/ mdud pa gsum la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bsam mo// srung skud la yi ge drug pa 'khril bar bsam/ de nas srung skud snyim par bcug la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pas rdo rje'i thag par gyur par bsam/ rang gi byed na mdud pa byed dus su sngags bdun bzla'o// snying rjes srung ba la gnad blo sbyong dang 'dra bar 'dug stong nyid kyis srung ba la/ rang gi lus grub phung po'i bdud// de la dbugs 'gro 'chi bdag bdud// nyon mongs gnas pa nyon mongs bdud// yul rten dga' skyed lha bu'i bdud// de rnams rang sems rnam pa tsam// lus grub na yang a nas grub// zhig pa na yang a nas 'jig /rang gi lte bar a dkar bsam// de las 'od byung lus gang nas// phyir 'phros snod bcud kun la phog /sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'od du yal// stong nyid ngang du ci gnas bzhag /ldang na a nas snod bcud kun// lha yi dkyil 'khor nyid du'o// gnas srung ba ni/ mal gyi zur bzhir hrīḥbazhi bsam/ 'og tu hrīḥmago thur bstan zhig steng du'ang 'og gi de 'dra zhig hrīḥbazhi 'od dmar khrug gis 'dres// 'og hrīḥme ni zur gsum 'bar// steng du'ang zur gsum 'bar bar bsam// steng mas lha bu'i bdud las srung*// phyogs bzhi'i mes ni rgyal chen bzhi'i// 'khor du gnas pa'i gnod sbyin srung*// 'og gi des ni gnod sbyin srung*// gzhi la sdod dus mi bsdu bar// srod la gsal gdab 'gro na bsdu// drag po'i srung ba rta mgrin no// sa gnyan sar sdod na thugs ka'i hrīḥ'i 'od kyis dmyal ba'i bar gyi nyes skyon sbyangs bar bsams nas bzla bar bya'o// bsdus pa'o// gtor ma brgya rtsa dang brul gtor 'dra/ sdig sbyong sdig pa gang yid la gcags pa de'i nang du sdig pa thams cad bsdus la lce thog tu nag bun ne bsam/

de nas yi ge drug pa bzlas pas phu chu drag pos bye ma la rgyab pa ltar har har zad par bsam/ 'jog khar sangs kyis dag par bsam/ stong pas rgyas btab/ dge ba bsngo/ stobs bzhi sbyor tshul gzhung na gsal/ sāts+tsha la/ 'jim steng hrīḥmathar yig drug bsam// de zhu shel gyi phung por mos// ma ṇi brjod nas las kun bya// rab gnas rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar// chu sbyin gzhan 'dra/ mdor bsdus ni/ snying rjes ma ṇi brjod cing chu gtor kyang chu mig 'bab chu sogs bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pas chog sbyin sreg zhi rgyas dbang drag thab// dbyibs ni spyi dang mthun par bsam// zangs gzhong nang du mar me bzhag /lhar bskyed rdzas ni 'bru sna tshogs// shing bal me tog gzugs byas pa// 'bul sngags yi ge drug pa la// zhi ba la shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā zhes sbyar/ de bzhin du rgyas pa la/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la/ wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ drag po la/ mā ra ya phaṭa/ sdig sbyor sbyin sreg chen po ni// me tog mang btus grib skam bya// las sbyor sa dkar tsan+dan dkar po'i chus chag chag btab/ de'i dkyil du dong zlum po/ zabs su khru gang kha skor khru phyed brus la de'i kha ras kyis bcad/ de'i steng du mañji bzhag de'i khar zangs la sogs pa'i snod kyi steng du yi ge drug pa'i sku rab gnas can bzhugs/ mdun du mchod pa bsham/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gi sdig pa thams cad sbyang du gsol/ sdig pa lci ba yod na de'i ming 'don/ lan gsum/ lag pa g.yas pas me tog blangs nas jo bo'i thugs kar dbul/ g.yon pas phreng ba bgrang*/ bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha phul/ dge rtsa bsngo/ rten phyir gshegs dong zhabs su spra ba dkar po blugs/ de nas me tog rnams blugs/ de'i khar shing shug pa zlum por brtsig dbul ba'i rdzas ni shug pa legs par gshags pa khri tsho gcig la snum byugs pa g.yas su bzhag

dong gi phyogs bzhir mchod pa tshar re re bsham/ nang du hrīḥlas yi ge drug pa bskyed/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyis mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bsam/ de rnams la dmigs pa mdun gyi mchod pa phul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ phyogs bcu na sogs nas dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig pa thams cad myur du zad par mdzad du gsol/ tshogs thams cad myur du rdzogs par mdzad du gsol gsum/ g.yon gyi mchod pa tshar gcig yi ge drug pa la dbul/ gsol ba sngar ltar ro// de nas me sbar la shug pa 'ga' re jo bo'i zhal du phul bas bde stong gi rang bzhin du ltem ltem song bdag gi sdig pa thams cad sangs kyis dag par bsam/ rdzas re re'i gsham du shān+tiṃ ku ru btags/ rdzas zad nas rgyab kyi mchod pa phul/ gsol ba lan gsum btab/ tshogs yod na bza'/ yang g.yas kyi mchod pa phul/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ bdag gi sdig pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes khri tsho gcig bzla'o// de nas bsreg spos lag tu thogs la/ jo bo la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gis dngos grub myur du thob par mdzad du gsol gsum/ dge rtsa bsngo/ thal ba rlung la bskur/ grul gtor btang*/ bsnyen pa byed na dge 'dun gyi tshogs gsog dang dkon mchog la mchod/ me tog dkar po spungs pa'i khar jo bo'i sku rab gnas can bzhag la me tog snyim pa gsum phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi don du mchog gi dngos grub myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol gsum/ grangs bsnyen rab 'bum tsho sum cu rtsa gnyis/ 'bring 'bum phrag bdun/ tha ma gsum/ yang jo bo nas brgyud pa'i yig rnying gzhan las/ dus bsnyen zla ba gsum/ grangs bsnyen 'bum tsho bco brgyad ces gsungs/ yang yi ge la lar 'bum phrag drug cu'ang bshad do// bsnyen pa ma song bar las sbyor mi rung*/
